method: Fresh browser context; browser harness actions and own screenshots only. No source, APIs, repository or earlier reports inspected. Browser-only restriction was instructional, not technical isolation.
starting_state: Payables list, Lena Fischer selected. Northform Studio NF-2026-041 had an outstanding confirmation for Mara Weber's approval of 800 Test USD. Credit CN-204 and original approvals already existed.
comparability_limits: This is a continuation from a pending approval, not an untouched invoice. Original approvals, credit application and blocked payment were reviewed as recorded evidence, not personally executed.
Completed the remaining approval and payment in synthetic Solana devnet Test USD; no real monetary value.
Desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 were tested. Screenshots are full-page captures at those widths.
Export download completed with failure:null, but file contents were not inspected; external explorer transaction pages were not independently verified.
Keyboard and accessible-DOM sampling is not a full assistive-technology or contrast audit.
actions: Checked pending approval status once. App explained that no transaction was being sent; later confirmed it was recorded without resubmission.
Opened the current payable; reconciled original invoice 1,000 minus credit CN-204 of 200 to 800 Test USD.
Selected Jonas Berg via visible Demo role and approved 800 Test USD. App changed to Ready to pay with 2 of 2 approvals.
Selected Alex Morgan. On mobile, opened Pay 800 Test USD, reviewed recipient and confirmed 800 Test USD once.
Observed Paid status and automatic Evidence tab containing eight events, including current approvals and confirmed payment.
Downloaded kontor-NF-2026-041-evidence.json through Export evidence (JSON), with failure:null.
Expanded Technical identifiers with Tab/Enter and activated Copy Recipient; app reported Copied to clipboard.
Returned to Payables and selected Paid 1; confirmed To pay 0, amount paid 800, and settled-this-session 800 at both viewport sizes.

find_understand_amount_document_context.reason: Supplier, invoice number, service period, issue/due dates, original amount, named credit and current amount reconcile plainly in document and review panel.

complete_available_approval_credit_steps.reason: Available remaining approval and payment were completed using visible role guidance and explicit amount-specific buttons. Credit was already applied at entry; that interaction cannot be scored independently.

understand_earlier_approval_authority.reason: Earlier approvals explicitly expired after CN-204; history shows version 1 superseded, current approvals version 2, and blocked earlier payment moved no Test USD.

interpret_final_payment_evidence.reason: Final Paid record, original-minus-credit equation, actor/time, distinct rejected versus confirmed events, explorer links and export are straightforward.

readability_navigation_accessibility_rec.reason: Recovery succeeded safely and responsive layout prioritizes payment review. Secondary text is small and pale; repeated View transaction link names give little distinction outside their surrounding event articles.

findings.title: Pending approval recovery is actionable and bounded
findings.observation: Check status explicitly said it verifies an already submitted approval without resubmitting; successful result unlocked role selection and retained one remaining approval.

findings.title: Revised obligation and authority are clear
findings.observation: Invoice 1,000 minus CN-204 200 equals current payable 800. Earlier approvals are marked expired, and both version-2 approvers are individually shown.

findings.title: Final record distinguishes settlement from rejected attempt
findings.observation: Eight-event evidence timeline preserves the rejected 1,000 attempt with no funds moved and separately records a confirmed 800 payment. Paid list uses AMOUNT PAID and To pay count is zero.

findings.title: Transaction link names repeat
findings.observation: All seven transaction links have accessible name View transaction. Article context distinguishes them in sequence, but a links-only navigation view would not identify the associated event.
findings.suggestion: Use event-specific accessible names, such as View transaction for Jonas Berg approval of 800 Test USD.

findings.title: Secondary text could be easier to read
findings.observation: Muted green metadata, event explanations and technical identifiers are visibly small relative to the strong amount and heading hierarchy, especially on mobile. No clipping was observed.
findings.suggestion: Increase supporting-text size or contrast while preserving the current hierarchy; measure contrast before claiming compliance.

final_accounting_record.approvals: Mara Weber and Jonas Berg approved 800 Test USD for current invoice version 2; original version-1 approvals for 1,000 expired after the credit.
final_accounting_record.interpretation: The synthetic obligation is settled at its revised amount. The rejected earlier 1,000 instruction is not another payment. The UI does not present a general-ledger journal, and none is inferred.

end_state: Paid filter selected on desktop 1440x1000. Alex Morgan role. Existing payable preserved and settled; no reset or new payable created.
